blocks.content: Explore a histogram to see how its bars group values into numeric ranges, not named categories.

blocks.title: Read a bucket and its count

blocks.content: Find **Random Timeseries Data**. The histograms on this dashboard reuse its numeric values.

This panel answers the question: How many values fall between 0 and 100, between 100 and 200, and so on? Here the ranges are set automatically from the data. The horizontal axis is the value range, split into buckets, and the vertical axis is the count of values in each bucket. Hover over a bar to read its bucket and count.

Compare a taller bar with a shorter one. The taller bar contains more values in its range. It doesn't necessarily contain the largest values. Position along the horizontal axis identifies the value range.

Unlike the library bar chart, its bars group numbers into ranges rather than named categories. It summarizes the selected observations without showing when each one occurred.
